answer.instructions: How severe is this bug report for a shopping app?
criteria: Trivial: a cosmetic flaw, such as a typo or a slightly wrong position, that changes nothing about using the app
Minor: a small annoyance with an easy workaround
Major: a feature is broken for some users, but they can still get their task done another way
Severe: a core feature is broken for many users and there is no workaround
Critical: data loss, a security hole, or the whole app down for everyone

items.state: The word 'recieve' is misspelled in the footer of the About page.
Any logged-in user can open another customer's order history by changing the order number in the page address.
Saved addresses don't load on the checkout page for some users. Typing the address in again works.
On Android, tapping 'Pay now' does nothing for every user, and there is no other way to finish a purchase in the app.
The search box forgets your last search when you go back from a product page. Typing it again works.
The 'Contact us' icon sits two pixels lower than the icons next to it.
Since last night's release the app shows a blank white screen on launch for every user on every device.
Product photos fail to load in the gallery view for users on slow connections. The list view still shows them.
Password reset emails are never sent, so users who forget their password cannot get back into their accounts.
The dark mode switch needs two taps instead of one to change the theme.
